name: shadow-commit
description: Agent middleware for TikTok TechJam 2026 Track C, The Kill Switch: every agent turn runs as a transaction against a sealed copy of its workspace, and its complete effect set is judged before anything reaches the real one.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @launchpad/server" "npm run dev -w @launchpad/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @launchpad/web && npm run build -w @launchpad/server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
